annotations.title: People who work at a company (public LinkedIn profiles)

description: Lists people who currently work at one company, from public LinkedIn profiles: name, profile URL, headline, current title and employer, location, and how well the employer match was confirmed. Use it to find the people at a company, for example its decision-makers, from the company's LinkedIn page URL. Cost: $0.00625 per employee profile plus $0.0075 per run, debited from your balance; only usable rows are charged, an empty or failed run is free. Auth: Authorization: Bearer <API key> (POST https://api.gaents.com/v1/accounts, $0.10 free credit); with no key the call returns a signed 402 quote payable in BSV or USDC via x402. Errors (isError, error.code): 400 missing_param/bad_param, 401 bad_api_key, 402 low balance, 503 job_unavailable, 502 job_failed (refunded).

company_url.description: The company's LinkedIn page URL, linkedin.com/company/<name>.

max_results.description: Most employee profiles to return and pay for (default 50, at most 500); the run stops there.

name: job_linkedin_profile

items.description: {fullName, firstName, lastName, profileUrl, publicIdentifier, headline, currentTitle, currentEmployer, location, company, confidence (high, medium or low), confidenceReason, verified, matchedTitles [title], scrapedAt}

usable.description: rows that carry data (only these are charged)
